slides.teacher_cue: New sound. Identical position to /f/ — upper teeth on lower lip — but with voicing. Hand on throat: /f/ no vibration, /v/ vibrates. Alternate f-v-f-v. The voiced counterpart to /f/, just as /b/ is the voiced counterpart to /p/.
slides.expected_response: Students produce /v/ cleanly as a voiced labiodental fricative with continuous airflow and voicing.
slides.correction_move: Tactile session: /f/ — air on hand, no throat vibration. /v/ — air on hand AND throat vibrates. Students alternate until they control the voicing switch.
slides.observation_note: Watch for /b/ substitution — the most common Korean interference error for /v/. Redirect with the labiodental position check.

slides.observation_note: Watch for /b/ substitution at onset — redirect with teeth-on-lip check.
